checks.only_changed_step: Install and launch the delivered APK on an isolated Android 35 emulator

reasoning: ANDROID_USER_HOME and ANDROID_EMULATOR_HOME share an isolated RUNNER_TEMP prefs directory; ANDROID_AVD_HOME is its avd child, eliminating inherited manager/emulator location disagreement. HOME and SDK installation root are not overwritten.
Every subprocess.run, subprocess.check_output and subprocess.Popen call uses the same copied environment. Only the three task-specific Android path variables are overridden.

avdmanager create receives an explicit --path. Emulator listing exit status, exact AVD name membership, .ini file and AVD data directory are checked before launch. check=False only permits diagnostic capture; assertions retain failure behavior.

Inventory records only the three non-secret path values, not the whole inherited process environment. Existing APK/source/signer identity, installed byte comparison, activity/PID checks, cleanup and timeouts are preserved.
